title: Tour De Murder
summary: A cyclist is found at the bottom of a ravine during the race.
method: The victim and the suspect had a row during a training run earlier that morning and the victim was pushed over the ravine. In the commotion, a piece of the suspect's shirt was ripped off. He threw it in the trash and it was found by a local boy who was scavenging. The second suspect then dressed up like the victim and started the race with the rest of the team. She then quietly left the race to establish her alibi for when the accident apparently took place. The first suspect continued the race and carried the GPS of the victim's bike, throwing it out when he reached the same bend in the road.
motive: The victim discovered the suspect had been taking performance-enhancing drugs and was about to report him to the authorities. The second suspect was the one supplying the drugs. The drugs were also supplied previously to the victim's sister, who lapsed into a coma after taking them.
killer: One of the other cyclists and the trainer for the group
